description: Baseline CDnet 2014 evaluation (corrected evaluation code: ground truth uses >0 threshold, fixed path and filename patterns). Overall F1=0.4598, P=1.0, R=0.2985. Processed 62 frames (2 per sequence).

Lowered edge_threshold from 25 to 15 in LightingInvariantConfig default. Increased sensitivity to weak edges, improving recall from 0.30 to 0.40 while maintaining perfect precision (1.0). F1 improved from 0.460 to 0.571 (+24%).

asi.hypothesis: Lower edge threshold captures more subtle motion edges, increasing recall without harming precision

description: Further lowered min_edge_movement from 2 to 1. This allows smaller edge displacements to trigger detection, boosting recall from 0.399 to 0.414 while maintaining perfect precision. F1 improved from 0.571 to 0.585 (+2.6%).

asi.hypothesis: Smaller edge movements still indicate motion, especially for slow-moving objects

description: Lowered contrast_threshold from 20 to 10 (LBP sensitivity). No significant change in overall F1 (0.5854 vs previous 0.5854). Precision remained 1.0, recall unchanged at 0.414. Indicates LBP contrast threshold not a limiting factor on this small sample.

asi.hypothesis: More sensitive LBP texture matching would increase recall
